With `optimization.model_snapshot_index="flat"` on a multi-period network, `create_model` still passes the original MultiIndex `sns` to `define_secant_loss_constraints`, but now calls it inside `_flat_snapshots_context`. That context makes snapshot-indexed `c.da` reads return the flat representation, so its per-snapshot line data is read in a representation fixed by the context rather than that of the supplied snapshots.
